d: Google, Microsoft and Canva are all shrinking their workforces as artificial intelligence changes the economics of Big Tech. Alphabet has expanded voluntary exit packages beyond the US, with employees in countries including Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland also being offered severance deals. Microsoft has made buyout offers to tens of thousands of employees, while Canva is restructuring more than 1,200 jobs — around 22% of its workforce.
